en: I bow to the Self-Existent One, who exists for the sake of the world, who is self-born, beginningless, absorbed in himself, and immutable;
I bow to that Self-Existent One who is free from the body, from calamity, and from the nature of old age. (1)
I bow to the Self-Existent One, who arises from the shining, beautiful pericarp of a thousand-petaled lotus, and who grants all desires.
I bow down to the Self-Existent One, who delights the thousand-rayed sun, who gladdens hundreds of thousands of moons, and who is venerated by the worlds of the gods and others.
You alone shine with virtues; established upon the earth, you manifest in splendor. You appear in the three realms—I bow to you, the Self-Existent One.
"I am this one"—even to investigate who this is, he was not able to do so with his heart;
I bow to that Self-Existent One who was perceived merely as a morsel of food. 5.
Those men who always joyfully recite this praise of the Self-Existent One attain the fulfillment of the three aims of life and obtain that very liberation.
The Svayambhūstotra, composed by Śikhin and extracted from the Śrī-Bṛhatsvayaṃbhūpurāṇa, is complete.
